title.narrative: Strengthening life-saving health services for vulnerable populations during the lean season in MMC LGA of Borno State.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed project aims to provide immediate, life-saving health and nutrition services to vulnerable conflict-affected populations during the lean season in Maiduguri LGA of Borno State. The intervention responds to the worsening health and nutrition conditions, among children under five, pregnant and lactating women, and other at-risk groups, driven by seasonal food insecurity, protracted conflict, and the deterioration of basic services. Through integrated health and nutrition outreach, mobile clinics, facility support, and community-based case management, the project will reduce malnutrition, prevent disease outbreaks, and mitigate mortality during the lean season. Implemented over six months, it targets approximately 17,700 individuals with essential health services and support. Key activities include integrated primary healthcare such as immunization, antenatal care, treatment of common illnesses, and mental health support in hard-to-reach areas, strengthen disease surveillance and rapid outbreak response for cholera, measles, and malaria, provide immediate treatment for severe acute malnutrition (SAM), and deliver sexual and reproductive health services including antenatal, delivery, postnatal care, emergency obstetric care, and GBV prevention and response, conduct GBV/PSEA awareness and referrals. Mobile Medical Team will lead community-based reponses, including referral of SAM/MAM cases and other illnesses to supported health facilities. Disease surveillance, early warning and Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE) will be prioritized, with awareness on disease prevention, Sexual and Gender-Based Violence (SGBV), and Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH). House-to-house campaigns will promote hygiene and health education, to reduce morbidity and mortality, especially from flooding, Acute Watery Diarrhea (AWD)/cholera, and malaria - the leading cause of death. Local community members and service providers will be empowered and trained to ensure sustainability, ownership, and a smooth transition at the end of the project.lt/pgt
